Modern 2-Bedroom A-Rated Newly Built Home – Short-Term Let (Oct16 2026 – 28th Feb 2027)
Rent: €2,000/month

Available: 16 October 2026 – 28th February 2027
No extension beyond 28th February 2027 under any circumstances 

2 Bedrooms (3-bed home with 1 room securely locked for storage)
2 Bathrooms
117 sq. m (1,260 sq. ft.)
Private driveway with parking
BER A2 | Fully furnished | Move-in ready

Before applying, I’d appreciate it if you could carefully re-read the full property description below and then confirm the following key points. As this is a short-term let, it's important that we're fully aligned and agreed from the start on all terms

This beautifully presented A-rated home is located in the highly sought-after Harpur Lane development – a modern, family-friendly estate in Leixlip. Offering bright, energy-efficient living with stylish finishes, this home is available for a fully furnished short-term lease.

Key Features

Bright open-plan kitchen/dining area with quartz countertops & integrated appliances

Separate utility room and guest WC

Cosy living room with comfortable, modern furnishings

Two spacious double bedrooms (1 ensuite), plus main bathroom

Heat pump system with zone-controlled panel radiators

MEV (Mechanical Extract Ventilation) system for continuous fresh air

High ceilings and excellent natural light throughout

Wired for high-speed broadband (Cat 6)

Landscaped front garden and off-street parking for 2 cars

Located in a quiet, well-maintained estate with green spaces

Prime Location

2-minute walk to the nearest bus stop

3-minute drive to Leixlip Louisa Bridge Train Station (Dublin City Centre ~25 mins)

4 minutes to Spar, 10 minutes walk to Lidl, Aldi, and Intel Campus

Easy access to N4/M4/M50

Close to schools, shops, cafes, sports clubs & leisure centres

Adjacent to Castletown Estate – 120 acres of beautiful parkland along the River Liffey
